description: Derived from AGSC-05-38 and AGSC-05-39: a node that declares a site vocabulary publishes every triple of the vocabulary file in the named graph of the Bundle, and an item that states a domain type, a role, a context and a domain link adds exactly the triples the rule names: a second `rdf:type` (the site class, the item keeps `asc:Concept`), `schema:additionalType` (the role), `dcterms:isPartOf` to the cluster that declares the context, the domain link as `<item> <site property> <target>`, and the computed inverse the vocabulary declares. The input gives the vocabulary text, three items and the site base; the expected value is the whole `graph.nq`. `jsonld_type` states the `@type` of `engine-a` in `graph.jsonld`: an array of the two classes in code-point order of their IRIs, the site class first. A node that declares no vocabulary emits none of these lines (the cases `graph-0026` and `graph-0028` stay as they are).
